analysis: The PR changes only PlacementSetupCheck.swift, a test-only check target (head lines ~1260-1264). It adds an explicit `publicModels: []` argument to two `ClusterPairServingGrants.publicTrafficLine` assertions and renames the check text to 'records only, no public declaration'. No production code, key handling, attestation, WebSocket, cache, or authorization path is modified in the supplied units. The assertions still expect a family without a passing record to return `notYetQualified`, and a passing hand-off family to return a 'qualified for public traffic' prefix. This implies the production `publicTrafficLine` signature gained a `publicModels` parameter, probably a public-declaration gate, but that source is not in this batch. I could not verify that gating, so I record it as an unverified contract rather than a finding. The base text for the surrounding tests (qualification records, grants, placement planner, bench chip, owner pilot) is unchanged context. I saw no new attack surface or threat-model assumption invalidated. Relevant threat areas (T-052 shadow evidence mistaken for permission, T-056 overclaimed attestation) concern the platform-owned policy and are not touched here. Integration should confirm that the production change keeps public-traffic qualification fail-closed when `publicModels` is absent or empty. The test no longer checks the case where `publicModels` includes the model and records are absent, so check coverage for that case should be confirmed elsewhere.
